name: Aelvar Cloudberry-Oolong Frost
description: A chilled tea soda made with real oolong extract and synth-cloudberry flavoring, lightly sparkling. Aelvar is a licensed boutique label under a larger corponation umbrella, given creative freedom to maintain its craft credibility.
flavor_profile: Delicate roasted oolong base with a tart, berry-forward cloudberry sweetness, light carbonation, and a cool, slightly astringent finish.
cultural_context: Aelvar is the go-to for Tier 3 consumers who want something that reads as sophisticated without committing fully to the price point of Tier 4 products. Its corponation backing is technically public knowledge but rarely discussed — brand mythology is carefully maintained.
story_hooks: Aelvar's parent corponation is planning to reformulate the product with cheaper synth-oolong, and an Aelvar brand manager is considering leaking the plan to protect the label's reputation.
A food critic's damning review of Aelvar went viral and then quietly disappeared — someone pulled it, and the critic wants to know who.
A case of Aelvar was found at a crime scene with no explanation for how it got there — it's a Tier 3-4 product in a Tier 1 location.
